about_the_game: Wanna try running your own apocalyptic restaurant with no commitments?! Try the "Taste Test" demo to play 3 in game days and get an idea if the flavor of the game is for you!

content_descriptors.notes: Cartoonish NPCs can be killed and possibly thrown in a meat grinder, it's up to you. Also, there's some swearing.

detailed_description: Wanna try running your own apocalyptic restaurant with no commitments?! Try the "Taste Test" demo to play 3 in game days and get an idea if the flavor of the game is for you!
name: Wasteland Kitchen: Taste Test (DEMO)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any modern sound card should work
  • VR Support: Not VR

short_description: Serve your customers, serve your customers to your customers; craft, fight, survive and explore the Wasteland.
